Acting as the bridge between Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT, you will challenge business requirements, drive fit-to-standard solutions, and ensure sustainable processes aligned with the global S/4HANA template.How You’ll Make an Impact * Advise business stakeholders on standard SAP S/4HANA processes and fit-to-standard solutions* Analyze, challenge, and document business requirements across end-to-end finance processes* Identify template gaps and drive continuous improvements aligned with the global rollout strategy* Support PMO activities during ongoing S/4HANA rollout projects and business transitions* Collaborate with Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT to ensure integrated end-to-end processes* Translate business needs into SAP system logic and enable standardized, scalable solutionsWhat You Bring* Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field* Significant expertise in SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) within global rollout environments* Strong understanding of COGS flows, variance analysis, transfer pricing, and intercompany processes* Experience with project-based manufacturing, engineering-driven businesses, and Group Reporting structures* Proven ability to challenge business requirements and drive standardization across cross-functional teams* Business fluent English; German is a plusAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer – Applied AI, Geodata Systems & Data Transfer (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description: Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available) Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent) Target Group: Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Full-Stack Developers, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders, and Master’s Graduates About Project Iris Project Iris is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, cadastre intelligence, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. Together with our commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH), we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application. Complex geospatial and resilience data models are deployed into active enterprise environments, stakeholder portals, and infrastructure tools. The resulting real-world usage and performance metrics are continuously validated and fed back into our open research models. In this role, you turn algorithmic frameworks and spatial datasets into robust, production-ready digital architectures. Your Focus & Responsibilities - Geospatial & Core Data Modeling: Develop and refine automated pipelines for spatial datasets, open-source cadastre records, and environmental scoring algorithms using Python. - AI-Assisted Full-Stack Integration: Transform algorithmic logic into high-performance FastAPI backends and connect them with modern React/Next.js frontends (leveraging cutting-edge tools such as v0.dev, Cursor, and Windsurf). - Applied Transfer & Enterprise Workflows: Implement real-world pilot applications by connecting data models to practical workflows (e.g., automated property screening, municipal portals, and ERP/Odoo interface connections for infrastructure). - Multi-Tenant Architecture & Cloud Deployment: Package services into robust Docker multi-container environments and deploy them on secure European/Swiss server infrastructure (Infomaniak VPS) with strict Row-Level Security (RLS) and data privacy standards. - Continuous Feedback Architecture: Establish data pipelines that capture operational feedback from commercial deployments to refine and advance the research models. What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Software Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent practical industry experience. - Core Technical Skills: - Solid programming foundation in Python (FastAPI, Pandas, data handling) and/or modern Web technologies (TypeScript, React, Next.js). - Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and containerization (Docker / Docker Compose). - Practical experience or strong interest in AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, v0.dev, LLM APIs). - Mindset: Strong analytical curiosity, proactive problem-solving attitude, and a clean-code engineering approach. - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, or EU Work Permit). - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus. What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories into Senior Engineering or Technical Leadership roles. - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: For candidates looking to combine full-time practice with further academic credentials, we offer tailored Master Trainee tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support. - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding support. - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and German residence/work permit applications. - Modern AI-First Work Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment where repetitive boilerplate code is automated, allowing you to focus on high-value architecture, data logic, and deployment. - Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de  (Subject: Application – Software Engineer Applied AI & Geodata)

jobs.occupation: Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager – Applied Geodata & Research Solutions (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description: Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available) Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent / Dual Master Track available) Target Group: Business Development Managers, Technology Transfer Specialists, Marketing & Sales Talents, Master’s Graduates, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders About Project Iris Project Iris is an applied research initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, land registry intelligence, sustainable infrastructure mapping, and open-source resilience modeling. To ensure long-term independence and funding for non-profit research, Project Iris works with an established commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH). Through this framework, proprietary data algorithms, geospatial scoring models, and automation tools are licensed and deployed across real-world commercial sectors (e.g., real estate, institutional investments, infrastructure providers, and SME enterprise solutions). Your Focus & Responsibilities - Research Transfer & Commercialization: Identify commercial use cases for our geospatial and resilience data models, translating scientific capabilities into clear value propositions for enterprise clients and institutional partners. - B2B Outreach & Pipeline Management: Lead proactive outreach campaigns targeting potential data partners, municipalities, enterprise clients, and specialized service providers using modern CRM and automation tools (e.g., Odoo ERP, automated email workflows). - Partner Onboarding & Account Management: Manage communication with corporate partners, coordinate pilot testing phases, and gather operational market feedback to help researchers refine underlying data models. - Marketing & Value Proposition Communication: Create structured presentation decks, use-case briefs, and digital campaign materials to position our data products in commercial and public markets. - Funding & Grant Alignment: Support the interface between commercial data licensing and applied research funding projects. What We Are Looking For - Educational Background: Degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, International Business, Marketing, Geoinformatics, Economics, or a related field. - Professional Competencies: - Strong interest in technology, spatial data, AI platforms, or digital business models. - Experience with or quick adoption of digital outreach tools, CRM systems (e.g., Odoo), and structured email communication. - High level of communication clarity, commercial acumen, and consultative relationship-building skills. - Mindset: Proactive, structured, and comfortable working at the intersection of non-profit research and commercial markets. - Eligibility: Open to local and international applicants currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, EU Work Permit). - Languages: Excellent working proficiency in English (required); good command of German is a strong advantage for the DACH market. What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Position: Long-term career security with direct exposure to executive management and commercial leadership. - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: We support continuous academic development through fully sponsored Master Trainee and Dual Master tracks. - Accommodation & Onboarding Support: Concrete assistance with local housing search, official registration, and structured onboarding. - Visa & Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive employer backing for German Opportunity Card conversions and residence permit processes. - Direct Business Impact: Drive the commercial sustainability of high-impact research projects without corporate bureaucracy. How to Apply Send your CV, references, and your earliest possible start date to: E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de  (Subject: Application – Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager)

jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Data Mining & Web Scraping Automation (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) About the Research Institute: The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) conducts applied research into spatial data systems, automated data extraction, and infrastructure transformation. We build scalable data pipelines to turn fragmented public records into structured spatial insights. What We Offer: We fully sponsor and support your relocation journey to Germany via the Opportunity Card framework, managing visa formalities, degree assessments, and onboarding logistics. You will benefit from organized accommodation, living allowances during training, sponsored German language classes, and hands-on exposure to production-grade data mining environments. Your Role & Key Tasks: You will design, develop, and maintain autonomous scraping routines and extraction agents for public registers, corporate filings, and official announcements. You will parse complex unstructured document formats—such as HTML, PDF, JSON, and XML—into clean, relational data structures, while monitoring data feeds and integrating incoming datasets into our core spatial repositories. Candidate Profile & Qualifications: Applicants should hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical subject. You should possess solid foundations or a strong motivation to develop your skills in Python (using libraries such as Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, or Playwright), text parsing, regex, and structured data modelling. Fluent English is required. How to Apply: Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter in English. We look forward to reviewing your application! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

jobs.occupation: Trainee / Specialist – Geospatial Data Engineering & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description: Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH) Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support) Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required) About the Research Institute: The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is a non-profit, applied research institute dedicated to developing cutting-edge spatial resilience data models and open-data architectures for the energy transition, critical infrastructure, and sustainable regional planning. What We Offer: We provide comprehensive administrative support for international candidates, including full assistance with the German Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), degree recognition, and visa procedures. You will receive structured onboarding, local accommodation support, coverage of basic living expenses during training, on-site sponsored German language courses, and access to a modern data engineering tech stack centered on Python, PostGIS, Docker, and GIS platforms. Your Role & Key Tasks: In this role, you will build and maintain automated Python-based spatial data pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms. We look forward to welcoming you to the IRIS team! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)
